pr_title: Show the most recent log entries on the status page

comments.comment: Each of the three new readers takes the last count entries with slice(-count). For count 0, which the change declares hides the section, slice(-0) is slice(0) and returns every entry. One shape in three places: one finding citing all three.
comments.failureScenario: recentErrors(log, 0) evaluates slice(-0), which is slice(0), and returns every error in the log rather than none, so a viewer who set the section to 0 to hide it sees the whole error history. recentWarnings(log, 0) and recentMessages(log, 0) do the same at lines 10 and 14: three readers, one shape.
